name: valora-plugin-ollama
description: Self-managed Ollama provider — downloads the Ollama binary on first use and runs it locally. Supports any model available via ollama pull.

requiresBinary.installCommand: command -v zstd >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt-get install -y zstd; curl -fsSL https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
requiresBinary.name: ollama
requiresBinary.postInstallCommand: ollama serve >/dev/null 2>&1 & TRIES=0; until curl -sf http://localhost:11434/api/tags >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ $TRIES -ge 10 ]; do sleep 1; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); done
